description: A stronger, more confident Enterprise faces Romulan intrigue, moral dilemmas and first-contact disasters while Data, Worf and Picard each confront questions of identity, family and duty before the Borg return in force.

s03e01.description: Wesley's escaped nanites evolve into a new intelligence and endanger a scientist's experiment that could reshape understanding of stellar evolution.

s03e02.description: Data must convince human colonists to abandon a world ceded to the Sheliak, while Picard searches their rigid treaty for leverage.

s03e03.description: An elderly couple appear to be the only survivors of a colony destroyed by raiders, but their impossible resilience hides a far larger act of grief and revenge.

s03e04.description: A primitive society mistakes Picard for a god after Federation observers accidentally expose themselves, forcing him to repair the cultural damage without reinforcing the myth.

s03e05.description: Worf takes responsibility for a boy orphaned on an away mission while an alien manifestation uses the child's memories to offer an unreal escape from grief.

s03e06.description: The Enterprise is caught in an ancient energy trap while Geordi works with a holographic recreation of a famous engineer to devise an escape.

s03e07.description: Geordi is stranded with an injured Romulan on a hostile planet, while Worf must decide whether to donate blood to save another Romulan aboard ship.

s03e08.description: Negotiators compete for control of a supposedly stable wormhole, and Troi becomes involved with a representative whose empathic abilities mirror her own.

s03e09.description: Riker investigates raids tied to a clan feud and becomes close to a servant whose true role in the conflict is far more dangerous than it appears.

s03e10.description: A Romulan officer crosses the Neutral Zone with a warning of invasion, leaving Picard to decide whether the intelligence is genuine or an elaborate trap.

s03e11.description: A genetically enhanced veteran escapes custody and exposes the prosperous society that created soldiers for war and then discarded them when peace returned.

s03e12.description: Crusher is abducted by separatists using a dangerous transport technology, placing the Enterprise between terrorism and a government unwilling to address its causes.

s03e13.description: Q is stripped of his powers and dumped on the Enterprise as a mortal just as the crew struggles to prevent a moon from destroying an inhabited planet.

s03e14.description: Riker is accused of murdering a scientist, and the holodeck reconstructs conflicting witness accounts that make the same events look entirely different.

s03e15.description: A damaged Enterprise-C emerges from the past and transforms history into a war-torn reality, forcing Picard to decide whether sending it back means certain death for its crew.

s03e16.description: Data secretly creates an android daughter whose rapid emotional development attracts Starfleet scrutiny and challenges his understanding of parenthood.

s03e17.description: Worf's brother arrives to reveal that their dead father has been branded a traitor, drawing Worf into Klingon politics and a conspiracy at the heart of the High Council.

s03e18.description: Picard is replaced by an alien duplicate while the real captain is imprisoned with strangers whose captors are studying how different species respond to authority.

s03e19.description: Picard's attempt at a quiet vacation on Risa becomes a hunt for an archaeological device involving a charming thief and time-traveling rivals.

s03e20.description: A gifted but unstable Betazoid specialist guides the Enterprise toward a living starship whose loneliness resonates with his own isolation.

s03e21.description: Barclay's holodeck fantasies about his crewmates become a professional problem just as an unexplained systems failure threatens the Enterprise.

s03e22.description: Data is presumed dead after a shuttle explosion but has actually been abducted by a collector determined to possess the galaxy's rarest objects.

s03e23.description: The legendary Vulcan ambassador boards the Enterprise for a final negotiation while an age-related illness causes his suppressed emotions to spill into the crew.

s03e24.description: Ferengi kidnap Troi, Riker and Lwaxana to exploit Betazoid telepathy, leaving Picard to perform an unexpectedly theatrical rescue.

s03e25.description: Crusher revives an amnesiac stranger whose emerging abilities suggest he is undergoing a transformation his own people fear enough to kill.

s03e26.description: The Borg return for Earth, abduct Picard and transform him into Locutus, leaving Riker to face the possibility that saving the Federation may require killing his captain.
